sub_graphs.title: EIP-2844: DID Authentication Flow
sub_graphs.description: Models the authentication flow using did_authenticate to establish RPC connection permissions

nodes.label: Unauthenticated Connection
nodes.description: Client has connected to wallet but has not authenticated to any DID method

nodes.label: Request did_authenticate
nodes.description: Client invokes did_authenticate with nonce, audience, and requested paths

nodes.label: Auth Request Received by Wallet
nodes.description: Wallet has received authentication request with challenge parameters

nodes.label: Verify Challenge Nonce
nodes.description: Wallet verifies the nonce is fresh and valid for replay protection

nodes.label: Prompt User for Path Permissions
nodes.description: Wallet displays requested paths/permissions and asks user for consent

nodes.label: User Granted Permissions
nodes.description: User has approved the requested path permissions

nodes.label: User Denied Permissions
nodes.description: User has rejected the authentication request

nodes.label: Create Authentication JWS
nodes.description: Wallet creates JWS with protected header containing kid and keyFragment

nodes.label: Connection Authenticated
nodes.description: Client has authenticated JWS and can use approved paths

external_entities.name: DApp Client
external_entities.description: Decentralized application requesting DID authentication with specific permissions

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2844: JWS Creation Flow
sub_graphs.description: Models the did_createJWS method for signing data with DID keys

nodes.label: Payload Ready for Signing
nodes.description: Client has prepared the payload and protected header for JWS creation

nodes.label: Invoke did_createJWS
nodes.description: Client calls did_createJWS with payload, protected header, DID, and revocable flag

nodes.label: Wallet Received JWS Request
nodes.description: Wallet has received the JWS creation request

nodes.label: Resolve DID Signing Key
nodes.description: Wallet resolves the DID to find the appropriate signing key

nodes.label: Sign Payload with Key
nodes.description: Sign the payload using secp256k1 or ed25519 algorithm

nodes.label: Build JWS Object
nodes.description: Construct JWS in general serialization format

nodes.label: JWS Created Successfully
nodes.description: JWS has been created and is ready to return to client

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2844: JWE Decryption and Permission Check
sub_graphs.description: Models the did_decryptJWE method with path-based automatic decryption

nodes.label: Encrypted JWE Received
nodes.description: Client has received an encrypted JWE and wants to decrypt it

nodes.label: Invoke did_decryptJWE
nodes.description: Client calls did_decryptJWE with JWE string and DID identifier

nodes.label: Decrypt Request Received
nodes.description: Wallet has received the decryption request

nodes.label: Decrypt JWE Payload
nodes.description: Decrypt using xchacha20poly1305 with x25519 key agreement

nodes.label: Check Paths in Decrypted Payload
nodes.description: Check if decrypted payload contains paths property matching authenticated prefixes

nodes.label: Path Matches Authenticated Prefix
nodes.description: Payload paths match previously authenticated path prefixes

nodes.label: Path Does Not Match
nodes.description: Paths do not match - requires user confirmation

nodes.label: Auto-Return Cleartext
nodes.description: Automatically return decrypted content without user confirmation

nodes.label: Prompt User for Confirmation
nodes.description: Request user approval before returning decrypted content

nodes.label: Cleartext Returned
nodes.description: Decrypted content returned to client in base64pad format

ambiguities.text: The meaning of 'paths' as permission prefixes and how they are matched is not precisely defined
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume paths are URI-like prefixes and matching is done by string prefix comparison (e.g., '/ceramic/' matches '/ceramic/documents').

ambiguities.text: No specification for what happens if nonce verification fails
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume authentication should fail with an appropriate error code if the nonce is invalid or replayed.

ambiguities.text: The 'revocable' flag in did_createJWS is mentioned but its exact behavior is not defined
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this flag indicates whether the resulting JWS can later be revoked, implementation-specific mechanism.

implicit_assumptions.description: Wallet implementations correctly enforce the path-based permission system and do not auto-approve decryption for unauthorized paths
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Unauthorized access to encrypted content if path checking is bypassed or improperly implemented

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot forge DID authentication responses or JWS signatures without access to the private key
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Complete compromise of DID identity - attackers could impersonate users and sign arbitrary data

implicit_assumptions.description: The cryptographic algorithms (secp256k1, ed25519, xchacha20poly1305, x25519) are implemented correctly and securely
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Cryptographic attacks possible leading to key recovery, signature forgery, or decryption of protected content

implicit_assumptions.description: Nonces are generated with sufficient randomness and uniqueness to prevent replay attacks
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Replay attacks possible where old authentication responses are reused
